headline: Bank of Industry and IFC Sign $50M Loan to Fund Nigerian MSMEs
summary: The Bank of Industry signed a seven-year $50 million loan with the IFC to expand longer-term financing for productive businesses in Nigeria's manufacturing, agriculture, and renewable energy sectors.
why: Development finance institution loans help expand lending capacity for small and medium enterprises in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Inflow of capital supports MSME growth and sectoral development.
